full_judgment: 5. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners contended that the learned Judges of the High Court Division erred in law in maintaining the judgment and decree of the trial Court in failing to notice that the plaintiffs-respondents instituted Other Class Suit No. 90 of 1994 in respect of the 'Ga' schedule lands seeking for declaration or title and recovery of khas possession in which suit they ought to have claimed for damages, if any, but they abandoned the said relief and therefore, the subsequent suit for damages is barred under Order 2 Rule 2 of the Code of Civil Procedure since they did not seek court's leave to institute a fresh suit on the same cause of action in the earlier suit:
